description: AICTIONBOT™ process lever by KULIC Advisory, built on the Execution Toolkit template T05 (process improvement). Takes the process steps with cases per year (or per month), minutes now and in the target state, and optionally rework rates and rework minutes, plus the hourly cost. Returns hours per year now and in the target state, hours saved, full-time equivalents and euros per year, the steps with the largest lever, steps that would get slower, the change of optional KPIs (baseline to target) and the inputs to continue in build_business_case. Example values (hourly cost 50 euros, 1,600 productive hours per full-time equivalent) are marked as such when the user gives none. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

hourly_cost.description: Hourly cost in euros. Default 50 (marked as example).

kpis.description: Optional KPIs with kpi, baseline, target.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

productive_hours_per_fte.description: Productive hours per full-time equivalent and year. Default 1,600 (marked as example).

steps.description: Steps: step, cases (per year) or cases_per_month, minutes_now, minutes_target, error_rate_now (percent), error_rate_target (percent), rework_minutes.

name: process_lever
title: Process lever: current and target minutes and rework per process step, turned into hours, full-time equivalents and euros per year
